Style/medium: hand-painted gouache with subtle colored-pencil texture on warm off-white paper. Clear educational illustration, softly lit, muted natural colors, fully visible subject centered in middle 80 percent with generous empty margin; legible at 640px.
Constraints: absolutely no words, letters, Chinese characters, numbers, written labels, captions, logos, watermarks, borders or card UI. Only the exact target sense. One image for this one sense, no multi-vocabulary collage.
